steps.en: Scaffold a new app from any directory
steps.zh: 在任意目录下脚手架一个新应用

steps.en: Prompts for framework, package manager, toolchain and which add-ons to include
steps.zh: 提问选哪个框架、包管理器、工具链，以及要包含哪些 add-on

steps.en: Answer the prompts, or pass the whole choice as flags
steps.zh: 回答提问，或把全部选择作为旗标一次给足

steps.en: Resolves add-on dependencies/conflicts, renders templates, installs, writes .cta.json
steps.zh: 解析依赖与冲突，渲染模板，安装依赖，写出 .cta.json

steps.en: Start the dev server and open the app
steps.zh: 启动开发服务器，打开应用

value.en: A running TanStack Start app with auth, database and deployment pre-wired — the integration boilerplate never passes through your hands
value.zh: 一个认证、数据库、部署都预先接好的可运行 TanStack Start 应用——集成样板代码完全不经你的手
